name: Sacleus
source:
Hierophant Sacleus is the highest ranking member of "Church of Radiant Dawn," a religious order on Verdigris V, and father of [url=/c173531]Raene[/url]. He's also the owner of the vessel "His Eternal Holy Light That Graces Our Paltry Existence A Thousandfold."

[Edited From In-Game Description]
